evidence.quote: We have self-contained accessible toilets with baby changing facilities.

findings.value: The main entrance has a ramp to the ground floor (council chamber, mayor's parlour, front room bar, toilets). A passenger lift serves the basement (The Ditch) and first floor, including the Assembly Hall stalls and committee rooms. The second-floor balcony is reached only by 66 steps, with one rest area. A signposted quiet space is off the foyer during performances. Companion tickets are complimentary for the venue's own cultural programme.

findings.value: Bookings carry a £2 fee per transaction. Concessions (students, under-25s, over-65s, unwaged, disabled people, and some local residents) apply to its own cultural programme; visiting companies set their own ticket types.
